run_hybrid_cpu_gpu_bench: run a benchmark to compare CPU and GPU hybrid search performance on FAISS IVF indexes
run_search_preassigned: run a batched preassigned search on a FAISS index using a separate coarse quantizer
run_tiled_search_preassigned: run a tiled preassigned search that overlaps coarse quantization with inverted list scanning
create_separate_coarse_quantization_inde: create a SeparateCoarseQuantizationIndex to manage a coarse quantizer and IVF index separately for hybrid search
create_sharded_gpu_index: create a ShardedGPUIndex with multiple GPU indexes sharing a common coarse quantizer for parallel search
